name: Michelle
creed: Enhanced. Connected. Humanity augmented. Information is power. Silence is survival.
desc: Augmented recon intelligence officer. Corrupts hostile target locks and moves before the correction lands.

trait.name: Signal Ghost
trait.desc: Hostiles lose your track 40% faster and their shots lead you incorrectly.

ability.name: Scramble Beacon
ability.desc: Blinds and disorients every hostile in a wide radius.

name: Michael
creed: Unwavering. Reliable. Builds the wall others fight from. Hold the line.
desc: Heavy weapons veteran in a reinforced field frame. Slower, far harder to remove.

trait.name: Composite Frame
trait.desc: Armor reduces damage by a flat amount and you cannot be knocked back.

ability.name: Bulwark Field
ability.desc: Projects a directional shield that absorbs incoming fire and reflects it.

name: Jimmy
creed: Natural leader. Calculated. Disciplined. Always three steps ahead. Mission success above all.
desc: Team commander. Fields interceptors and keeps every system on his rig cycling faster than doctrine allows.

trait.name: Fast Recompile
trait.desc: All weapon cooldowns are reduced by 12% and ability recharge is 25% faster.

ability.name: Interceptor Swarm
ability.desc: Releases a swarm of attack drones that hunt independently for 12 seconds.

name: Kade
creed: You never see him. That is the point. Silence is the deadliest weapon.
desc: Close-range infiltrator. Rewards aggressive movement and punishes anything that lets him get close.

trait.name: Afterimage
trait.desc: Dashing leaves a decoy and grants +45% damage for 3 seconds.

ability.name: Phase Strike
ability.desc: Blinks through the nearest cluster of hostiles, cutting everything on the path.

name: Miguel
creed: Excellent field judgment. High adaptability. Operates beyond enemy perception.
desc: Long-range reconnaissance specialist. Reads the field far enough ahead to fire where a target has not arrived yet.

trait.name: Combat Analysis
trait.desc: +18% critical chance and criticals mark targets for +25% damage from all sources.

ability.name: Arbitration Window
ability.desc: Slows every hostile to a crawl for 5 seconds while you keep full speed.

name: Vincent
creed: Unpredictable. Volatile. Destruction is his language. Control the chaos, or be consumed by it.
desc: Demolitions specialist with an unhealthy relationship to blast radius calculations.

trait.name: Overpressure
trait.desc: All explosions are 35% larger and deal 20% more damage to elites.

ability.name: Demolition Order
ability.desc: Saturates the surrounding area with a rolling barrage of charges.

name: Sarah
creed: Information is power. Knowledge is survival. Control the narrative.
desc: Counter-intelligence officer who turns hostile hardware against its owners. The battlefield stops being entirely theirs.

trait.name: Subversion
trait.desc: Killing a machine has a 20% chance to reanimate it as a temporary ally.

ability.name: System Purge
ability.desc: Detonates every status effect currently on the field simultaneously.

name: Korey
creed: Young. Fast. Ruthless. Fear is a liability. Control is a weapon. Trust no one. Except your team.
desc: Young, fast and off the books. Trades survivability for a kill rate command will not put in writing.

trait.name: Entropy
trait.desc: You take 25% more damage, deal 40% more, and every kill briefly restores health.

ability.name: Last Rites
ability.desc: Consumes all active phantoms in a detonation scaled to how many were held.
